#### Summary

One book holds nine diagrams; one thought determines the fate of the world!  
Gu Changsheng returns reborn with the Primordial Heavenly Book, and from then on, treasures from all realms, ancient secret realms, lost inheritances... all become part of his domain!  
What's even more amazing is that those peerless, aloof female sword immortals, saintesses, empresses, and demonic enchantresses... What? You say they are the pride of the world, untouchable?  
Sorry, in this picture, they are all my personal sword servants whom I nurtured and raised!  
"Want to become my Daoist partner and share eternal life?"  
"Alright, first help me nurture this Myriad Swords Dao Embryo to its full potential!"  
In this life, I will control the universe with the map in my hand!
